pieces.name: main
pieces.notes: single large hip over the whole footprint, 52 by 57 ft, near pyramid; S hips meet at about (552,507), N hips at about (550,467), so a short N-S ridge

pieces.name: north diamond
pieces.notes: dark uniform diamond on the N half bounded by the two N hip lines and two lines meeting at the N eave centre; looks like a glass or dark atrium or skylight section, not shingle; roof type uncertain, LiDAR decides; could also be a sunken courtyard

notes: one big hip block, confidence high on the block and ridge direction; the dark diamond on the N side is the only unknown (atrium, skylight or courtyard), medium confidence overall. Exclusions: separate lower roof touching the S eave, detached garage or neighbour structure, outside the traced outline
